title: The Last Review Slot in an Online Queue
grain: One timestamped main-namespace English Wikivoyage revision, with complete future label horizon
question: When should an online reviewer spend the last daily slot on the current edit?
design: Replay real UTC arrivals in order. Use anonymized arrival-visible edit properties to estimate seven-day identity-revert risk on matured history. Compare a fixed threshold, time quota and marginal inventory-value policy with two hindsight bounds. Use the same finite daily capacity and examine burst days separately.
boundary: An identity revert indicates that previously observed page content returned within seven days. It is a behavioral proxy. The replay assumes no effect of the simulated review on subsequent edits.
redistribution: Released extract omits names, IP addresses, page text and comments; attribution to Wikimedia contributors and the public release.

fields.reverted: Subsequent identity revert within seven days
